python3 << 'EOF'
# Japanese Yen
jpy_options_billions = -74  # billions of Japanese yen
jpy_exchange_rate = 114  # yen per USD

# Convert to millions of USD
# -74 billion yen = -74,000 million yen
# Divide by exchange rate to get millions of USD
jpy_options_millions_usd = (jpy_options_billions * 1000) / jpy_exchange_rate
print(f"JPY net options in millions of USD: {jpy_options_millions_usd}")

# British Pound Sterling
gbp_options_millions = 369  # millions of pounds sterling
gbp_exchange_rate = 1.41  # USD per pound

# Convert to millions of USD
gbp_options_millions_usd = gbp_options_millions * gbp_exchange_rate
print(f"GBP net options in millions of USD: {gbp_options_millions_usd}")

# Calculate absolute difference
absolute_difference = abs(jpy_options_millions_usd - gbp_options_millions_usd)
print(f"Absolute difference: {absolute_difference}")

# Round to hundredths place
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(absolute_difference, 2)}")
EOF
